debian_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact inherited Debian 13 findings in the development image while vendor patches and package removal are tracked. This does not assert non-exploitability. Do not expose this image as a production service.

kernel_headers.reason: Reviewed header-only attribution: linux-libc-dev owns userspace headers under /usr/include and /usr/lib/linux/uapi, not an executable kernel implementation. The 51 changed-version pairs are individually reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-05.md; evidence and remediation are in .devcontainer/security-remediation.md. Host applicability and privileged Docker-in-Docker remain open in cos-dam4 and cos-2jj7; cos-nxu6 remains their owner. This does not claim the host kernel is patched.

libxml2_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance pending Debian 13 fixes and review of tools that parse untrusted XML inside the development image. CVE-2026-6653 is tracked as a minor issue by Debian.

openssh_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance for development SSH client use with trusted servers and host-key verification while Debian 13 patches are pending. Review CVE-2026-60002 and other matching advisories.

go_binaries.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact findings in pinned prebuilt Go tools. Update or rebuild each binary when its publisher ships patched Go or module dependencies; tool input and registry access remain in scope.

pip_vendor.reason: Temporary acceptance of msgpack and setuptools versions vendored by pip 26.2.1. Independently installed project packages are patched; update pip when its bundled components change, and keep package sources trusted.
